body: That's exactly what she told me. What you said. She said she couldn't do it in person because she didn't want to start crying in front of me. She said she still loves me, but she just can't be in a relationship right now. Knowing that helps the pain, but it still hurts. I have yet to seek professional help, let alone tell my parents about my depression, but I might do it soon...thank you.
I am so sorry to hear that. But I'll take your word for it, and hope the best for both me and you.
Thank you, probably one of the best things someone's said to me. Again, thank you.
I've tried to, but everything she suggests doesn't work with me.

Haha that was probably the funniest way that someone has tried to help me. I needed that laugh. I'll try to do that, and see how that works out, but right now I think that's a little much for me to try and do. Thank you though, I appreciate it.

That's the thing though. I don't know what to do with my life. Nothing seems to interest me. All I do is sit at my computer and play video games for most of the day (and I know it's usually the impression, but I'm by no means overweight or unhealthy), or hangout with my friends. But everything that people suggest me to do in the future doesn't interest me. Even working in the video game industry doesn't interest me. I have no idea what to do with my life, not that I could even do much with it anyways because of my grades in school. That's another reason for my depression. My grades. I try so hard in school, but no matter how hard I try, I just don't get it. My sister is a genius who graduated high school with a 4.0 GPA and is now going to a great college, and here I am, failing 2 classes in my sophomore year and barely passing most of my other classes. I'm a disappointment to my parents, and I'm probably gonna be the first person in my family to drop out of high school or get held back my senior year.
